invariants.rationale: BaseHoodieWriteClient is used for upsert and commit, so it should not be null or the method would fail.
instantTime is used as a commit instant identifier for upsert and commit; it should not be null for correct write logics.
preppedRecordInputs is used as input to upsertPreppedRecords and must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
Covers the possibility that preppedRecordInputs may be empty or not, but avoids assumptions.
writeClient should be an instance of BaseHoodieWriteClient due to the method signature.
